item.title: Presenting the Trade-off Instead of Guessing
item.description: A pattern that keeps showing up across my projects: when a decision is irreversible, costly, or genuinely ambiguous, the right move isn't to guess well — it's to lay out the real trade-off and let the person who owns the consequences choose.
item.author: Victor Williams

item.title: Build vs. Buy: Why My Admin Panel Doesn't Use Firebase Auth
item.description: A real, small architectural decision — and the honest tradeoff that came with it — walked through in full: SHA-256 over Firebase Authentication for a low-stakes admin panel.
item.author: Victor Williams

item.title: My Framework for Cutting Things I Just Built
item.description: A real, blow-by-blow account of simplifying my own portfolio's homepage — and the rule that came out of it: real data or no data, never fake-but-impressive.
item.author: Victor Williams

item.title: Building a Modern Portfolio with React + TypeScript
item.description: A comprehensive guide to creating a professional portfolio website using React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.
item.author: Victor Williams

item.title: Mastering Core Web Vitals for Peak Performance
item.description: Learn how to optimize your website for Google's Core Web Vitals metrics - FCP, LCP, FID, CLS, and TTFB - with practical techniques and real-world examples.
item.author: Victor Williams

item.title: Integrating Sentry and Analytics in Production React Apps
item.description: Complete guide to implementing Sentry error tracking, performance monitoring, and Google Analytics 4 in production React applications with TypeScript.
